statements.status_notes: Backported upstream commit https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/pipewire/pipewire/-/commit/8e3a214ecfd9aece7eaabb67d29ade3496b9bbdf. The PulseAudio protocol server now skips client-supplied pipewire.* properties in the remap path, so a client cannot set server-controlled keys such as pipewire.client.access. Debian trixie and sid still list this package without a fixed version; the scanner has no fix-version data for this CVE.
